description: This file implements the PUCCH collision management logic for 5G NR scheduling, including resource info creation, collision detection, and resource allocation for PUCCH resources within a cell.

classes.name: pucch_collision_manager
classes.description: Manages PUCCH resource collision detection and allocation within a cell, including handling common and dedicated resources, collision matrices, and multiplexing regions.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the collision manager with the current slot point, resetting previous slot context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears all slot contexts and resets the collision manager state.

methods.name: alloc_common
methods.description: Allocates a common PUCCH resource for a given slot.

methods.name: alloc_ded
methods.description: Allocates a dedicated PUCCH resource for a given slot.

methods.name: free_common
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated common PUCCH resource.

methods.name: free_ded
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated dedicated PUCCH resource.

methods.name: get_ded_idx
methods.description: Returns the internal index for a dedicated PUCCH resource based on its ID.

methods.name: build_mux_region_lookup
methods.description: Builds a lookup table mapping resources to multiplexing regions.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Performs resource allocation for a specific resource index, checking for collisions.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a resource at a specific index, updating collision states.
